title: The Workshop Can Wait
short_role: Choose whether to restore the support chain or staff it before the flank arrives.
setup: Sabotage has left the Workshop strained. The masons can rebuild it now, or a nearby Repair Station can commit its crew before the flank arrives.

choices.label: Repair Workshop (8 materials, 1 action)
choices.visible_result: The Workshop can support the next defense again, at the cost of materials and one recovery action.

choices.label: Assign Repair Station to Workshop (1 action)
choices.visible_result: The Repair Station crew commits to the Workshop, preserving materials but giving up another recovery action.
